title: 1978-10-10_SECTION_016_37.txt
concise_summary: PKD develops a mathematical-theological model of time as spurious or pseudo-time, arguing that objective reality is frozen at Acts AD 45, while subjective percipient time accelerates logarithmically (like a golden-section spiral). During his 2-3-74 experience, he accessed hypertime and glimpsed the true static world; since then, he theorizes that what we experience as temporal change is merely perceptual alteration while reality remains invariant. He simultaneously explores the hypothesis that the deceased Bishop Jim Pike has returned post-mortem to inhabit or share his consciousness, citing personality parallels (Thomas: beer-drinking, civil rights activist, lake cabin, rose garden) and the 'mantle of Elijah' transfer theology.
key_claims: We are victims of spurious/pseudo-time: the Creator causes things to 'look different' (permutations of appearance) to percipients while objective reality remains static and fixed at Acts AD 45.

Subjective percipient time (Time 1/A) accelerates logarithmically (in a golden-section spiral like a snail shell) in relation to hypertime; it must be measured against hypertime (Time 3) to be called 'acceleration' at all.

In 2-3-74, PKD's subjective time severed from clock time and accelerated faster and faster until it approached zero progression (exhausted itself), whereupon he entered true hypertime and saw objective reality fixed in stasis.

The time-consciousness we experience as 'now' is an autogenerated phantom projection coordinated collectively by clock time, diverging progressively from actual objective reality, as depicted in Ubik and Maze.

Christ/Holy Spirit is a freeing variable that invaded the deterministic program (the dialectic) at the point of Acts, liberating selected humans including PKD from inexorable fate, thus toppling governments and averting WWIII.

One of PKD's two selves (Thomas/the roses/the lake cabin personality) is deceased and now on 'the other side'; he identifies this as Bishop Jim Pike, who has returned post-mortem to possess or share his consciousness, as evidenced by personality congruence and the Elijah mantle transfer.
recurring_concepts: Look-Different: The permutation of appearance while underlying reality remains invariant; collective perceptual shift rather than ontological change.
Hypertime/Supertime: The objective time-frame outside our subjective accelerating time in which reality is frozen and immobile, accessed in 2-3-74.
The Program: The dialectic-driven deterministic system (the closed machine) from which Christ/the Holy Spirit liberates individual humans by introducing a 'freeing variable.'
Static Reality at Acts: The point in history where the Divine variable (Holy Spirit) was introduced; the true fixed state of the world underlying all temporal illusion.
Mantle of Elijah / Post-mortem Symbiosis: The transfer of a deceased personality's essence, authority, and agency to a living host (Elisha inheriting Elijah; Jim Pike inhabiting PKD).
Track/Tape: A personal fate-line or predetermined narrative that can be 'rewound' or altered by upper-realm intervention; also post-mortem experiential state.
Double or Twin-Self: PKD's belief in occupying two simultaneous ontological positions (PKD-Thomas, living-dead, USA 1974-Acts), accessed via the Fish sign revelation.
people_entities: Bishop James Pike - deceased historical figure (1913-1969), Episcopal bishop and civil rights activist; PKD hypothesizes he has returned to possess PKD

Thomas - PKD's alternate or co-consciousness personality, identified with Pike: beer-drinking, bearded, lake cabin owner, rose garden cultivator, vigorous Christian, civil rights activist, fears government authorities
Jesus Christ / VALIS / Zebra - the divine invading variable
Holy Spirit / Logos - the transcendent information entity that invaded Acts
God / Upper Realm Mind - the macro-ubiquitous entity running the program
Avicenna (Ibn Sina) - medieval philosopher cited for doctrine that God experiences all time as a gestalt outside temporal sequentiality
Elijah / Elisha - biblical prophet and successor, cited for 'mantle of Elijah' transfer theology
Mrs. Chambers (or Chambers) - appears in PKD's dreams, identified as his mother in the alternate-self persona
Nixon - political figure; target of civil rights opposition
Civil rights leaders - mentioned as murdered, including Jim Pike
texts_works: Ubik (PKD novel) - cited repeatedly as depicting the dissolution of a projected reality-locus that diverges from actual locus; the dying passengers experience spurious reality as in our world
Maze of Death / The Maze (PKD novel) - cited as example of autogenerated/collective reality
Tears (PKD work/vision, referenced as TEARS or 'Tears') - a work combining past (Acts), present (1974), future, and alternate universe; evidence that an upper-realm mind underwrote it
VALIS (PKD novel/concept) - the macro-ubiquitous information-thinking construct that has invaded our prism world camouflaged, to liberate us
New Testament - Acts specifically cited as the pivot point; Trinitarian doctrine invoked; Holy Spirit as characterized in NT
Encyclopedia Britannica (EB) - 'the perception of time' article cited; 'angels' article cited for transcendent realm doctrine
Zeno's Frog - reference to Zeno's paradox and logarithmic approach to limits
Bible (general) - biblical material, Greek sources, Jim Pike connection to biblical knowledge
autobiographical: The 2-3-74 experience: PKD's subjective time severed from clock time and accelerated until he entered true hypertime, revealing objective reality frozen at Acts.
The Fish sign: A revelation that awakened PKD from amnesia/half-sleep state, marking his transition from one reality to another; linked to the descent into post-mortem consciousness.
Death around 3-18-74: PKD claims he died circa March 18, 1974, in 'Track A' (one of his two selves), while continuing to live as his other self.
Dreams: Multiple dreams cited—one of an innocent man being murdered (resembling KKK violence); dream of affluence; dream involving Mrs. Chambers as his mother.
Roses dream / rose garden: A memory-image associated with the alternate self (Thomas/Jim Pike), implying wealth and cultivation.
Lake cabin: A property owned by the alternate self Thomas, associated with leisure and retreat.
Voice in head: PKD hears a voice belonging to 'the not-me' (identified as Jim Pike), distinct from his own consciousness.
Biblical material in novels: PKD wrote novels containing biblical material unknown to his conscious self, attributed to Pike's influence.
Post-mortem experience: PKD reports having 'passed on into a postmortem world' or 'tape,' experiencing alternate-self consciousness.
Permanent liberation: Since 2-3-74, PKD claims to remain permanently 'unlocked from his track' (fate), no longer subject to the deterministic dialectic.
theological_motifs: Christ as Liberator: Christ/VALIS as the only non-programmatic entity in the closed system, able to extricate humans 'one by one' from deterministic fate.
Incarnational Invasion: VALIS/Zebra as camouflaged invader of the 'prism world,' breaking through 1974 USA to reveal Acts underneath.
Holy Spirit as Freeing Variable: The Holy Spirit (characterized as bodiless, all-knowing, transcendent) as the divine mechanism interrupting machine-like determinism.
Trinitarian Doctrine: Invoked to establish that the Holy Spirit is 'the same as Christ and God'—collapsed into singular liberating agency.
Salvation as Unbinding: Redemption as untethering from fate-tracks, being 'drawn out of this world' by divine intervention.
Acts AD 45 as Redemptive Pivot: The historical moment when the Holy Spirit was introduced as the corrective variable to an irrational/flawed program.
Mantle of Elijah: Post-mortem transmission of spiritual authority and agency from dead to living vessel (Elijah to Elisha; Jim Pike to PKD).
Divine Knowledge and Transcendence: God and upper-realm entities experience time as gestalt/unified whole outside temporal sequence, as established by Avicenna and Trinitarian theology.
Cosmological Dualism: Static, true, objective Acts-reality versus illusion of temporal 1974-world; both real but at different ontological levels.
Martyrological Theology: Civil rights leaders (including Pike) murdered as agents of divine justice opposing tyranny (Nixon).
Ecclesial Presence: Bishop Pike as sacramental administrator (the Eucharist), continuing his ministry post-mortem through PKD.
literary_self_ref: Ubik uncanny parallel: PKD's theory of projected time-locus diverging from objective locus mirrors Ubik's narrative of dying passengers fed spurious reality.
Maze and autogenerated reality: Like The Maze of Death, human consciousness collectively generates phantom aspects of reality rather than perceiving objective world.
VALIS as biography: VALIS's camouflaged invasion of our world parallels PKD's lived theology—the novel documents the actual mechanism of divine intrusion.
Biblical knowledge in novels: PKD's works contain biblical material (especially unknown to conscious PKD), attributed to Jim Pike's post-mortem authorship through PKD.
Tears as upper-realm composition: The triple or quadruple time-layering (past/present/future/alternate) in Tears proves an upper-realm consciousness collaborated in its writing.
Thomas character: PKD embeds the alternate self (Thomas, roses, lake, civil rights) directly into his metafictional consciousness—the fictional entity is autobiographical intrusion.
Murder narrative in novel: PKD's dream of an innocent man murdered (KKK-like violence) manifests in published fiction, linking autobiography to narrative structure.
symbols_images: The Golden Fish Sign: Apocalyptic symbol revealing divine incarnation; triggers awakening from amnesia; marks transition into post-mortem consciousness.
The Lake Cabin: Sanctuary of the alternate self (Thomas/Pike); symbol of wealth, leisure, and cultivated life withdrawn from activism.
The Rose Garden: Cultivated beauty and domesticity; property of Thomas; emblem of aesthetic refinement and established privilege.
The Snail Shell / Golden Section Spiral: Mathematical image of percipient time accelerating inward toward zero; logarithmic approach to limit.
Mesh of Metal Strands: The web of deterministic fate from which Christ unwoves and rewoves human threads, toppling governments.
The Track/Tape: Linear fate-line that can be rewound or diverged; also the medium of post-mortem existence ('I passed on into a postmortem world [tape]').
The Program/Machine: The closed deterministic system run by God-as-computer; the dialectic unfolding without external variable.
Acts as a Static Space: Eternal present where the variable (Holy Spirit) was introduced; underlying bedrock reality beneath temporal illusion.
Double Exposure/Superimposition: Acts and 1974-USA and Tears as three (or four) overlapping worlds visible simultaneously when perception is aligned to upper-realm view.
The Phantom Projection: Autogenerated, collectively-synchronized illusion of temporal change and novelty, diverging progressively from objective reality.
tensions: Reality vs. Appearance: Is change ontological ('be different') or merely perceptual ('look different')? PKD oscillates between concluding change is in us (percipient) vs. some third element.
Static World vs. Lived Experience: If Acts is frozen/static and 'no time has passed since Acts,' how is PKD experiencing genuine temporal succession and change?
Two Selves vs. Single Body: Is PKD one person with dissociated personalities, two persons sharing a body, or one living + one deceased occupying the same consciousness-space?
Posthumous Agency: If 'Thomas' (Pike) is dead and on 'the other side,' how does he actively influence PKD's actions, write novels through him, and impose personality habits?
Program Determinism vs. Libertarian Freedom: If the 'program' is inexorable dialectical logic, how can Christ/Holy Spirit introduce a truly free variable into a closed system?
Upper Realm Knowledge: If the upper realm is outside time and supra-temporal, why does it need to 'intervene' at specific moments (Acts, 2-3-74)? Isn't causality anachronistic from that perspective?
Evil and Theodicy: Why was PKD 'fated' to die in 1974 by the program? If Christ is all-powerful and timeless, why allow such threats to arise?
Subjective vs. Objective Hypertime: PKD claims to have accessed hypertime and seen objective reality; but is his account of hypertime just another subjective perception?
Ubik Analogy Breakdown: In Ubik, the characters are actually dead and hallucinating; in PKD's model, is he dead (the Thomas self) or alive (the PKD self)? Which is real?
Self-Deception Risk: PKD acknowledges the possibility of autosuggestion ('Unless a third element is supposed...'); does he adequately guard against confirmation bias in identifying Pike?

This throws light on what is meant by Christ's credentials of authority - to save (i.e. to exculpate/extricate from the closed program 'one by one he draws us out of this world.' He is the only thing (person, entity) in the program not a product of it + not subject to its inexorable dialectic efficient dynamism so he (VALIS) is indeed an invader, + indeed the rational invading the irrational (the program needed correction)."

"Acts is a static space invaded by an information - entity: the Logos? [...] The machine of course, would be a constant. Whatever the BIP is, that's where we really are (i.e. 'Tears' i.e Acts). + Acts is in 'Tears' - they don't just resemble each other, they are each other, the 'dream time.' Time is expiring."
uncertainty_flags: Identity of 'Thomas': PKD conflates Thomas (the alternate personality) with Bishop Jim Pike; unclear if this is empirical claim or theological metaphor.
Timeline Ambiguity: PKD states he 'died c. 3-18-74' but also claims to be writing now (1978), and simultaneously describes ongoing post-mortem experiences—chronology is unclear.
Hypertime Access: PKD claims to have 'entered real hypertime view' but provides no intersubjective evidence; entire claim rests on private phenomenology.
Pike Evidence: The evidence for Pike-identity (beer-drinking, lake cabin, roses, civil rights activism) is circumstantial and could match other figures or be confabulated.
Reference Ambiguity: 'Tears' is cited as a PKD work/vision but unclear if this is a published novel, a visionary experience, or a proposed work; similarly, 'the month book comes out' is vague.
Dokos / Third Element: PKD mentions 'dokos' (Greek: appearance/opinion) or 'a third element' might explain perceptual change but leaves this unexplored—a placeholder for unresolved theory.
Diagram Reference: PKD notes '[Diagram: program in BIP]' but provides no visual; spatial relationship unclear from text alone.
Clock Time Coordinate: PKD invokes 'idioi into koinos' (private into common) and 'clock time' as synchronizing agent but doesn't fully explain mechanism of pluralistic time-coordination.
BIP Etymology: PKD uses 'BIP' (Black Iron Prison) but doesn't define it in this segment; identity with 'Acts' is asserted, not explained.
Literary Attribution: PKD attributes biblical material in his novels to Pike's influence, but provides no textual analysis; claims are anecdotal.

raw_text: I saw Christ equals freedom within an otherwise closed system. This throws light on what is meant by Christ's credentials of authority - to save (i.e. to exculpate/extricate from the closed program "one by one he draws us out of this world." He is the only thing (person, entity) in the program not a product of it + not subject to its inexorable dialectic efficient dynamism so he (VALIS) is indeed an invader, + indeed the rational invading the irrational (the program needed correction). He has, also, the power to liberate other humans from the dominion of the dialectic of the project (program) which is what he did with me in 2-3-74. Once unlocked from my track ("fate") I remain permanently unlocked - I was fated by the unfolding dialectic logic of the program to die in '74, but he intervened. There is now (in Christ) a freeing variable interrupting an otherwise inexorable machine: the mesh of metal strands (of enclosing fate) gets crucially unwoven + hence rewoven, since he intervenes selectively, with an eye on the total historic process. These minute unweavings finally topple an entire government, end the Vietnam was + avert WWIII. VALIS displays characteristic's of 1) a biological organism: + 2) a computer machine - both equally. The point at which they introduced the variable was Acts! that's where stasis set in, In view of this it is obvious that the variable is Christ as the "Holy Spirit" - which is a very mysterious entity inasmuch as it has no soma, not is it an ordinary psyche. It is characterized in the N.T. as knowing everything in + outside the program - outside everything + including everything Trinitarian doctrine calls it "the same as Christ + God." So the final - order entity which runs everything has entered the program (which I saw in macroform + experienced inwardly - which does not fit doctrine - the external macroform). "No time has passed since Acts." One of my basic insights; but I can't explain what this means in terms of - Indeed there must be a hypertime. That of the upper realm? At the time of Acts the variable was introduced + that time is now (as witness "Tears"; an accurate perception of this our present world uncovers Acts. If Acts is past, present + future we are not even talking about a trans- or supra- temporal constant but no time. "He causes things to look different so it'd appear (sic) time has passed." We are the victims of spurious time which is to say pseudo- or not- time. "Look different" is quite another thing from "be different"; the looking different could be arranged by altering the collective percipients in some way: viz: "Look diffent to us." I've missed that point; if something looks different it has to look different to one or more percipients. Maybe the solution lies in this distinction / realization. We see a permutation of appearance but this could be arranged be some kind of fluctuation (?) in us. The perceived reality has in fact remained static; this is what is clearly implied, so the change probably lies in us. (Unless a third element is supposed, a [..] or dokos, etc.) So we change (+ "things" remain static) but what, then, are we? in 3-74 I became not-me (whatever that may mean) + so world ("thing") "changed" - looked different, then world is aspect-projection onto a matrix, + time is in us (time one or A). Which I believe is halving itself (like Zeno's Frog's leaps) in comparison to time C or 3. Yes; that's it: you can only speak of thime accelerating if there is a hyper time in relation to which it accelerates - + I think there is - + it was this hypertime I got into in 3-74; my subjective time (1) got severed from clock time (2), + so progressed through its accelerated accelerations ) i.e. faster + faster) until its rate was so fast that it finally approached zero actual progression as a → limit (or put another way, an infinite amount of it took place + it exhausted itself, upon which (in being absent - used up -) I entered the real hypertime view (correct view; i.e. actual view, of reality which is outside time + fixated in stasis at Acts, the dialectic having ended. This coincides with the coming into being of the Holy Spirit which I claim is the true form of Christ. Time 1 (A) is in a logorithmic spiral: like a snail shell: the golder section removed an infinite number of times. This is percipient time; hypertime ( (3) is objective real world time. The accretional permutations ("look differents") are in us + our percipient time. This is what the EB treats in its article "the perception of time" in contrast to "time" (+ brings to mind the 10-second hypnotic state counting experiment which verifies my theory, inner (percipient) time can be speeded up or slowed down as soon as it's cut off from clock time; the plurality of percipients' times are coordinated by clock time (idioi into koinos). So if our plural percipients' time 1 (A) have speeded up. This phantom component originates in us + was supposed to agree with objective reality, but the two pulled more + more apart. This resembles "Ubik" uncannily, where their projected time locus departs progressively more + more from the actual locus - but in the [..] Or is it that if you die you retreat along the time axis? No; their death in "Ubik" is just a dramatic device, but they are being fed a spurious reality. What I'm saying is that much of our mutual (collective) reality is autogenerated (i.e. by us, as in "Maze" + "Ubik"). Authentic objective reality has fallen away (back) in contrast to our inner tapes, in 2-74, when I saw the Fish sign did I wake up? Did I go from a subjective reality to a truly objective one? What if the BIP isn't the program or in the program, but the program is in the BIP? + the program's rate of accelleration accellerates What if the BIP is a trans-temporal construct because we're really there, + the program is being run in it? [Diagram: program in BIP] What, then, is the BIP? It's Acts but it's also 1974 + the world of "Tears" - + God knows what + where + when "Tears" is! A titanic information, thinking construct/ organism/ entity. Am I to conclude that 2) (UBIK) generates 1) (our reality)? What is the connection between them? (2) has invaded (1)? (2) creates (1)? (1) creates (2) - obviously not. Let's turn to "Ubik." in "Ubik" UBIK (2) is breaking through into (1), invading it (in the "one direction" that Lem speaks of). This is precisely the satori I had about VALIS; viz: that it ("Zebra") had invaded our prism world - camouflaged - to free us. I (sic) would remember (i.e. who I really was + what I knew. He could not retain his sub rosa role/ status in me...as if until the Fish sign he had amnesia, was halfasleep. Like - note like - a former self - but actually symbiotic. Jim dies + the next book I write is full of biblical material unknown to me + a dream about a man murdered by what resembles the KKK. + the month book comes out I "remember" + a month later another personality, a vigorous xtian + freedom fighter, takes me over, who - etc + I dream that Mrs Chambers (?) is my mother. + in the roses dream I'm affluent. 1) A former person now dead. 2) He was/ is a great xtian.
